en:
## New Features

- When Codex refuses image generation with a 403, the error card now offers a one-click "turn off image generation and retry" action for admins
- OAuth apps gained a message detail ceiling (none / summary / full), so an integration can read message structure without ever seeing reasoning bodies or tool payloads
- External API v1 now serves messages in layers (skeleton / summary / text / full), each with its own item and byte budget
- Codex CLI header emulation is now a per-provider switch, with a description of exactly which headers are sent
- Reflection failures now say which check could not complete and show the retry count, instead of failing silently

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a hang where a failed danger-reflection check left the turn waiting forever
- Fixed a deadlock between reflection requests and the update gate
- Narrators no longer get stuck showing "running" after their turn already ended
- Fixed subagent restarts after compaction: some runs span, others were skipped
- Clicking a Mermaid diagram no longer makes it jump to full size
- Custom retry rules now match again when the keyword was copied from a visible error card
- Migrations no longer re-run a destructive step whose rebuild already took effect, and repair missing tables instead of failing startup
- Uploading several images at once no longer leaves files behind when one of them fails

## Performance

- Message list folding is now animated on the compositor, without recomputing layout
- Revisiting a narrator paints from a cached document before the network responds
- Model refreshes now share one in-flight request and back off from unresponsive gateways
- External message sends no longer authorize the same operation twice

## Security

- WebSocket request dumps now record the headers actually sent, with credentials masked
- Outbound User-Agent strings are now length-bounded
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- Codex 以 403 拒绝图片生成时，错误卡片为管理员提供一键「关闭图片生成并重试」
- OAuth 应用新增消息详情上限（无 / 摘要 / 完整），可以只读消息结构而不接触推理正文与工具载荷
- External API v1 支持分层读取消息（骨架 / 摘要 / 文本 / 完整），每层各有条数与字节上限
- Codex CLI 请求头仿真改为按提供商可开关，并明确说明会发送哪些头
- 反思失败时明确提示是哪一项检查未能完成并显示重试次数，不再静默失败

## 修复

- 修复 danger 反思检查失败时回合永久挂起
- 修复反思请求与更新闸门之间的死锁
- 叙述者不再在回合结束后仍显示「运行中」
- 修复压缩后子代理重启的判定：此前有的空转、有的漏重启
- 点击 Mermaid 图表不再导致其跳到完整尺寸
- 从错误卡片复制关键词创建的自定义重试规则重新生效
- 迁移不再重跑已生效的破坏性步骤，并会修复缺失的表而非直接启动失败
- 批量上传图片时若其中一张失败，不再残留已写入的文件

## 性能优化

- 消息列表折叠改为合成层动画，不重算布局
- 重新进入叙述者时先用缓存文档绘制，无需等待网络返回
- 模型刷新并发共享同一请求，并对无响应的网关退避
- 外部接口发送消息不再对同一操作重复鉴权

## 安全

- WebSocket 请求转储改为记录实际发送的请求头，并对凭证脱敏
- 对外发送的 User-Agent 增加长度上限
